## 1. The gate and the word  (`#the-gate-and-the-word`)

Cited ayat: 2:58-59, 7:161-162

> **2:58** وَإِذْ قُلْنَا ٱدْخُلُوا۟ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ فَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ رَغَدًا وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطَٰيَٰكُمْ وَسَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
>
> **2:59** فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ

> **7:161** وَإِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ وَكُلُوا۟ مِنْهَا حَيْثُ شِئْتُمْ وَقُولُوا۟ حِطَّةٌ وَٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْبَابَ سُجَّدًا نَّغْفِرْ لَكُمْ خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِكُمْ سَنَزِيدُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
>
> **7:162** فَبَدَّلَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلًا غَيْرَ ٱلَّذِى قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِجْزًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَظْلِمُونَ

### Claims

**c1** (2:58, 7:161): They were told to enter this town (7:161 says to dwell in it) and to eat from it wherever they wished, in plenty.

**c2** (2:58, 7:161): They were told to enter the gate bowing down and to say hittah; God would forgive their wrong deeds, and He would increase the reward of those who do good.

**c3** (2:59, 7:162): Those who did wrong changed the word for another word than the one that had been said to them.

**c4** (2:59, 7:162): So God sent down on those who did wrong a rijz from the sky (7:162 says sent upon them), because of their disobedience (7:162 says because of their wrongdoing).

### One-minute summary

They were told to enter a town, eat from it freely, enter the gate bowing down and say hittah [c1][c2]. Those who did wrong changed the word, and God sent a rijz from the sky on them [c3][c4].

### Complete story

They were told to enter this town and to eat from it wherever they wished, in plenty [c1]. They were to enter the gate bowing down and to say hittah [c2]. God would forgive their wrong deeds, and He would increase the reward of those who do good [c2].

Those who did wrong changed the word for another word than the one that had been said to them [c3]. So God sent down on them a rijz from the sky, because of their disobedience [c4].

### Deep study

The passages give the instruction in a different order: 2:58 speaks of entering while 7:161 speaks of dwelling [c1]. 2:59 names the reason for the rijz as disobedience and 7:162 as wrongdoing [c4]. The word hittah and the word rijz are left untranslated here because the ayat do not explain them [c2][c4].

### Kids mode

They were told to go into a town, eat what they liked there, go in through the gate bowing down and say one special word [c1][c2]. Some of them changed the word, and God sent something from the sky upon those who did wrong [c3][c4].

### Life lessons (educational interpretation)

Educational interpretation (not scripture): One reading is that the passage sets a plain instruction beside a plain act of changing it [c2][c3]. Another is that forgiveness is described as following the saying of the word and the bowing at the gate [c2].

### What the sources do not establish

- Not established: which town is meant, who is addressed, and when this happened; the ayat name neither the town nor the people.
- Not established: what hittah means or what the changed word was.
- Not established: what the rijz was; the Arabic word is read in more than one way and is left untranslated.
- The verses do not say whether every person among them changed the word; they speak of those who did wrong.
